summary: 🏆 1st Place @ GDG Hackathon! Lumina (formerly CampusFind) is an AI-enhanced lost-and-found portal. Integrates Gemini AI for multimodal item matching and TomTom Maps for real-time geolocation. Built with React & Firebase.
